description: Fixed agent-typical prompt corpus for the SB quality gates (ADR-038). Used by ppl-delta, token-identity and golden drift measurements once the real oracle runs (S2.c). The prompts cover the shapes where quality regressions hide: tool-call formatting, transcript edits, multi-turn continuity, decision-style enumeration.

prompts.prompt: Call the calendar_create_event tool to schedule 'Review LOLA benchmarks' tomorrow at 14:00 for 45 minutes. Emit the tool call in the LFM3 XML format with parameter tags.
Here is the assistant's previous reply: 'The entry was rejected because volatility was expanding.' Rewrite it to be more concise while keeping the same meaning.
In our earlier session we decided to benchmark A0 before A1. Continue from there: what should the A0 acceptance criteria cover, and which instrument should we replay first?
Explain why decision d-41 was rejected by the risk engine. List the failed checks in order and what the operator should verify before re-submitting.
Using only the knowledge graph, list the instruments whose last regime was UpTrend and their liquidity state.
